req.title: Reject squadNumber lookup for non-numeric value
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer segment.
triggers: reject squadnumber lookup for non-numeric value

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-037 requires HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer path segment. The FastAPI route declares `squad_number: int` via `Path(...)`, so FastAPI's own validation rejects non-integer segments before the service layer is reached. Test design covers: (1) a positive case with a valid integer squad number that exists in the fixture (EP – confirms the happy path returns 200, not 422, catching any mutation that inverts the status code check); (2) a negative case with a purely alphabetic string (NEG – canonical non-numeric input, directly exercises R-PLAYER-037); (3) a boundary case with a float-like string '10.5' (BVA – numeric-looking but not an integer, sits at the boundary between numeric and non-numeric); (4) a negative case with a special-character string (NEG/DT – exercises the decision table branch for symbols); (5) a boundary case with an empty-ish segment represented by whitespace (BVA – edge of the non-numeric partition). Each test asserts the exact HTTP status code (422 or 200) to kill constant-mutation and comparison-flip mutants.

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200
preconditions: App is loaded in-process via FastAPI TestClient
Fixture row with squadNumber=10 (Lionel Messi) exists in the database
expected: Response body contains squadNumber 10 and lastName Messi
trace: R-PLAYER-037 — confirms the non-error path (integer segment) returns 200, not 422; kills any mutation that flips the 200/422 constant
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'
